simple.summary: בִּאוּשׁ (biʼûwsh) means wicked First listed occurrence: Ezra 4 12.

definitions.full: H873. bish [ בִּאישׁ K § 11, 8b )] adjective bad (so Egyptian Aramaic Cooke 75. 2 ; בִּישׁ ᵑ7 , Syriac ); — feminine singular emphatic וּבִאישְׁתָּא Ezra 4:12 rebellious and bad city (not בִּאוּשְׁתָָּא , see Baer n .). בָּתַר בָּאתַר, see אֲתַר .
